subject: PayFlux ML Screen — ephemeral VM provisioning + debrief plan
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@payflux.com>, Alex Serrano <alex.serrano@payflux.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: PayFlux ML Screen — ephemeral VM provisioning + debrief plan

Hi Emily / Alex,

Thanks again for coordinating — excited to run the 60-minute ML coding screen for PayFlux on Thursday 7/23 at 10:00am PT. Quick operational notes so we’re aligned on infra and debriefs: 

- Environment: we plan to use an ephemeral VM (Ubuntu 22.04) that we provision for the candidate and teardown after the session. I attached the screen runbook and a small provisioning snippet for your infra team to inspect.
- Access: candidate will receive a CoderStack link (below). For debugging we’ll also provide a temporary VM account (no persistent data).
- Interviewers: Karthik (ML), Kimberly (systems) and Marcus (proctor) will join.
- Run length: 60 min (40 min coding + 20 min debrief).
- Recording & consent: we’ll capture a short recording for debrief and ask candidate permission at the start.

Action items for PayFlux: can you confirm whether your network requires a VPN or IP allowlist for outbound SSH/CoderStack? If so, please send the IP ranges we should request. Also confirm the candidate name and pronouns so we can include in the runbook.

Links: https://coderstack.io/session/px-7a9f2b (candidate session)
Attachments: payflux_screen_runbook.pdf, vm-provision-snippet.sh

Thanks — I’ll provision the VM and post the ephemeral creds once you confirm network constraints.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Hiring Operations, Redwood Inference

Thanks Emily — adding details below so your infra can whitelist before the session.

IP ranges to allow (outbound from PayFlux to our ephemeral host):
- 34.217.120.45/32 (provisioner)
- 3.210.98.12/32 (coderstack relay)

Ephemeral VM access (we’ll post real creds ~10 minutes before start):
- Host: ephemeral-ml-01.px.redwood.internal
- User: candidate_samir
- Shell: disabled by default (use web terminal via CoderStack).
- If you need SSH: we can inject an ephemeral public key — please confirm the key (recommended) or we can use a one-time password.

Candidate session: https://coderstack.io/session/px-7a9f2b (this will open the web IDE + terminal; VM mounted read-only).

Runbook highlights (attached):
- 00:00 — intro + consent + environment check
- 05:00 — quick system warm-up (dataset + I/O)
- 10–50: coding task (ML model debugging + small feature impl)
- 50–60: debrief (confidence, edge-cases, follow-ups)

Marcus — can you confirm you’ll act as proctor and where you’ll capture notes? I’ll own the candidate admin and debrief doc.

Tessa

- PayFlux action: whitelist 34.217.120.45 and 3.210.98.12 (Emily)
